tiebreakers.description: Lower number on Player Order token

endCondition.description: Game ends after the third Eclipse, or the Eclipse triggered by placing the final Pyramid tile.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Each Eclipse: Avenue of the Dead steps x lowest visible building number; furthest on Pyramid track +4; Pyramid steps x4/3/2 by Eclipse; mask sets 1/3/6/10/15/21/28; salary of cocoa (-3 VP per unpaid cocoa); all normally already on the VP track. Dark Eclipse variant: higher token number wins the last tiebreak (not modelled). Solo Teotibot adds 1 VP per leftover resource/cocoa and 2 VP per Technology tile at the third Eclipse (not modelled).
